title: A Scaled Gradient Modified Non-monotone Line Search Method for Constrained Optimization Problems
summary: In this paper, we propose a scaled gradient modified non-monotone line search method for solving constrained minimization problems, and explore several specific properties of this method, namely, its convergence analysis. We discuss the linear convergence rate of the sequence generated by the proposed algorithm to a solution of the constrained minimization problem where the objective function is strongly quasiconvex.
